en: A black and white photograph showing a large, well-preserved castle complex on a hill, surrounded by old residential buildings with gabled roofs, a river, smokestacks from an industrial building, and lush tree coverage. The castle features several towers, a large main building with ornate facades, and fortified walls. Some faint handwriting is visible in white along the lower edge.
